newsitem.title: USA: Primestar to add BET's Black Entertainment.
newsitem.headline: Primestar to add BET's Black Entertainment.

text.p: Satellite television entertainment service Primestar Partners said on Monday it would add BET Holding's Black Entertainment Television to a package planned for release next year.
Primestar said in a statement it would include Black Entertainment in its PrimeValue package when it launched its GE2 successor satellite early next year.
Black Entertainment Television was formed in 1979 to meet the informational needs and interests of black Americans.
Black Entertainment delivered programs to about 46.4 million households nationwide, Primestar said.
PrimeValue, Primestar's basic programming package, offered subscribers 64 channels of news, family, sports and music programming for about $32.99 per month.
